stops.text: 9 YET HEARD · A The EX in the crowd — “accepting you'll never”
9 YET HEARD · B Walking toward the moon — “we look at the moon—”
9 YET HEARD · C Suitcases at the phone booth — “You help me”
9 YET HEARD · D The call to Mother — “I call on my mother.”
9 YET HEARD · E Father and son to the inner harbor — “I call on my Father”
9 YET HEARD · F The EX turns to haze — “yet, broken—”
